english: A massive pillar of ancient stone.
Could easily crush you if it fell.
You wrap your arms around the base.
A few inches off the ground.
Knowing you could lift more if you wanted.
This is what it means to be a man.
A sharp pain shoots up your spine.
You stumble back, clutching your lower back.
E-"I am a MAN." (Leave while speaking aloud to no one.)
You did your best to get the loot behind this thing.
If you told me, I could have helped, you know? But you didn't exactly give me a chance to-
There was no loot behind it.
I just lifted it to prove I could.
For the satisfaction of knowing- I could do that. That I am A MAN.
He walks up to you and pats you on the back.
